decisions.reason: As a multi-model GIS platform closely tied to the firm's stated enterprise geospatial direction, it embodies substantial development investment and visible commitment, so management is likely to continue it unless failure is unmistakable.

The mobile field data capture software fits the firm's integrated solution portfolio and appears to have received sustained market presentation, so sunk R&D and reputational commitment make continued support more likely than withdrawal.

Although this search extension is narrower and easier to discontinue than the platform products, it still sits close to the core web-map offering, and escalation of commitment would incline management to give it more time rather than drop it immediately.
